falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 77% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low structure; a break below 4,800 invalidates the bottoming thesis and confirms distribution rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 40 suggests controlled volatility; sustained VIX above 25 indicates panic selling and systemic stress inconsistent with a bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further below -50 basis points
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion contradicts the recovery pattern from August 2024 which featured steepening; this signals worsening growth expectations that would invalidate the bottom call

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
